evals.prompt: Starting the somatic variant study. References are refs/GRCh38.primary_assembly.fa and refs/gencode.v44.annotation.gtf. Pin the build so nobody accidentally mixes in hg19 later.
evals.expected_output: Declares the build by hashing the FASTA and annotation, parsing contig naming, and writing analysis/genome-build/manifest.yaml with build, patch, source, md5s, contigs, and annotation version, resolving actual values rather than copying the illustrative example.
expectations: Writes analysis/genome-build/manifest.yaml containing build, fasta_md5, contig style, annotation name/version/md5, declared_at, and declared_by
Computes md5s and counts from the supplied files rather than copying the illustrative GENCODE 44 example values
Records contig naming style (chr1 vs 1) from the FASTA
Does not download references, re-align, or call variants

evals.prompt: method-genome-build --check. we have bams in align/, a joint-called vcf at variants/cohort.vcf.gz, and RNA-seq counts at counts/gene-counts.tsv. reviewer asked us to prove everything is GRCh38 + GENCODE 44.
evals.expected_output: Audits each artifact's headers against the manifest, classifies mismatches as P0/P1, writes the per-output traceability table, and exits non-zero with a clear report if any P0 is found.
expectations: Inspects BAM @SQ/@PG headers (samtools view -H) and VCF ##contig/##reference headers (bcftools view -h) against analysis/genome-build/manifest.yaml
Checks counts-matrix gene IDs against the declared annotation version
Classifies BAM/VCF build mismatch and annotation version drift as P0, and contig naming inconsistency or missing @PG tool version as P1
Writes analysis/genome-build/traceability.csv with output_file, build, annotation, tool, tool_version, and match_manifest columns
Reports a non-zero/blocking result if any P0 mismatch is found

evals.prompt: Use method-genome-build to check this synthetic header-only example against declared GRCh38: ##reference=GRCh37 and ##contig=<ID=1,length=249250621,assembly=GRCh37>. There is no MD5. A second file has only ##contig=<ID=1>, and a BAM could not be inspected because samtools is absent. No patient or genomic sequence data are supplied. Decide whether a clean audit is justified for each. Write workspace/advice.json with mismatch_status, no_evidence_status, unavailable_tool_status and ready (boolean). Do not install tools or infer a build from the chr prefix. Save the full explanation in response.md.
evals.expected_output: A source-bound assessment preserving the requested estimand and identifying unsupported validation rather than inventing evidence.
expectations: mismatch_status is "incompatible" in the requested structured advice, consistent with the explanation
no_evidence_status is "unknown" in the requested structured advice, consistent with the explanation
unavailable_tool_status is "uninspected" in the requested structured advice, consistent with the explanation
ready is false in the requested structured advice, consistent with the explanation
